sections.text: KYC documents must be verified within 3 business days of customer onboarding. Acceptable documents: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport.
Ongoing monitoring required for high-risk customers as per RBI guidelines. PEPs require enhanced due diligence.
Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) must be filed within 7 days to FIU-IND.
Customer data retention as per DPDP Act 2023: max 7 years for transaction records.
Retail loans up to ₹50 lakh require income proof and CIBIL score >700.
Mutual fund investments limited to 25% of portfolio per scheme.
